terminal-frogger.notes: Declined 2026-11-04: the repository has no licence, so it can't be redistributed.

oregon-trail.notes: Declined 2026-11-04: the repository (yudonglin/Oregon-Trail) has no licence, so it can't be redistributed.

hammurabi-python.notes: Declined 2026-11-04: the repository has no licence. Tuikio already has a Hamurabi (hamurabi, from bsdgames' BASIC lineage).

just-asteroids.notes: Declined 2026-11-04: it reads keys with the `keyboard` library, which needs root access to /dev/input; a phone game process has neither.

chs.notes: Declined 2026-11-04: it plays by starting a bundled Stockfish executable (python-chess SimpleEngine.popen_uci); games can't start programs. nchess and ASCII Chess are in the catalog.

onx.notes: Declined 2026-11-04: there is no public server to connect to (players run their own); online games need one.

ssh-games.notes: Declined 2026-11-04: its only server was milek7.gq, and free .gq domains were taken back by the registry in 2023; no reachable server is documented.

roguelike-gallery.notes: Not added 2026-11-04: rlgallery.org's site couldn't be reached from the build machine to confirm its SSH or telnet endpoint. Add it to tools/ports/families/online.py once the endpoint is confirmed.
